Mā te tuku `-` ki mua o *<field>* ka rapu i te korenga o tētahi uara i taua āpure (hei tauira, ka rapu a `has:-due` i ngā kāri kāore he rā tika).

globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Ka taea te tohu pūwhakahaere maha.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ka honoa ngā pūwhakahaere ōrite mā te *OR*. Ka whakahokia ngā kāri e ōrite ana ki tētahi here.
Mā `__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` ka whakahoki ngā kāri kei roto i tētahi rārangi ko *Blocked*, ko *Available* rānei te ingoa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Ka honoa ngā pūwhakahaere rerekē mā te *AND*. Ko ngā kāri anake e ōrite ana ki ngā pūwhakahaere rerekē katoa ka whakahokia. Mā `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` ka whakahoki anake ngā kāri i te rārangi *Available* whai tapanga *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Ka taea te tohu rā hei tau tōpū tōrunga, tōraro rānei, mā `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__`, `__predicate_year__` rānei mō te wā o nāianei.

database-migration-description: Hekehia ngā raraunga ā-kuputuhi (ngā mea katoa hāunga ngā āpitihanga me ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi, ka noho ki te pūnaha kōnae) i waenga i MongoDB me FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Me whakahaere, me taea hoki te toro atu ki tērā atu pātengi raraunga (ngā tauranga taunoa: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; whakakapia mā WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Ina oti, tohuhia a MONGO_URL ki tērā atu pātengi raraunga, ka tīmata anō i WeKan (ki Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb, =mongodb rānei).

sandstorm-migration-description: Ina rere a WeKan i roto i tētahi kākano Sandstorm, ka heke tōna pātengi raraunga MongoDB 3 tawhito ki FerretDB v1 (SQLite) i te whakarewatanga tuatahi, ā, ka nekehia ngā āpitihanga me ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi mai i te pātengi raraunga ki ngā whaiaronga files/attachments me files/avatars o te kākano. Ka whakaatu tēnei mēnā i angitu taua hekenga, e hia hoki te mokowā kōpae e whakamahia tonutia ana e ngā kōnae pātengi raraunga MongoDB mata tawhito i roto i te kākano, ā, ka āhei koe ki te muku i aua kōnae mata hei whakawātea mokowā.

sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Whai muri i tētahi hekenga angitu, kei FerretDB me te pūnaha kōnae ngā raraunga, nō reira ka taea te muku i ngā kōnae pātengi raraunga MongoDB 3 mata tawhito hei whakawātea mokowā kōpae kākano. Kāore e taea te wete.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Mukua ngā kōnae pātengi raraunga MongoDB 3 mata hei whakawātea mokowā kōpae? Kua heke kē ngā raraunga ki FerretDB me te pūnaha kōnae. Kāore e taea te wete.

cards-loading-description: Ka uta a WeKan i ngā kāri papa aunoa: ka uta tētahi papa nui (kei runga ake i te paepae rahinga) i ngā kāri e kitea ana i taua wā anake (panuku mutunga-kore), me tētahi kaute ora, kia tere tonu, kia iti ake hoki te pūmahara me te hōkaiipurangi; ka uta ngā papa iti ake i ia kāri mō te wheako māmā rawa, whai āheinga katoa. Kāore he mea hei whirihora. Ka taea tonu e ngā kaiwhakahaere te whakahau i tētahi aratau mā ngā taurangi taiao CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) me CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: He whakamātau te utanga kāri mangere: he tika ngā kaute kāri me ngā tepe WIP, engari ko ngā tirohanga Maramataka/Tūtohi/Gantt me te tīpakonga-maha ka whakaata i ngā kāri kua uta noa iho. Utaina anō ngā papa tuwhera i muri i te huri i tēnei.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakaaturia ngā hono katoa (ngā hono markdown pēnei i [label](url) me ngā tūtohu HTML mata <a href>) hei kuputuhi noa kāore e taea te pāwhiri i ia āpure kuputuhi whai rawa (ngā taitara papa me te kāri, ngā whakaahuatanga, ngā tākupu, ngā rārangi arowhai, aha atu). Ka ārai tēnei i ngā hono pāwhiri whakapohehe. Kua weto taunoatia, nō reira ka taea tonu te pāwhiri i ngā hono.
always-show-code-as-text: Whakaatu waehere katoa hei kuputuhi noa i ngā wā katoa
always-show-code-as-text-description: Ina whakahohea, kāore rawa te kuputuhi whai rawa e tāhuatia hei markdown, hei HTML rānei: ka whakaaturia te pūtake katoa hei kuputuhi noa i ia āpure kuputuhi whai rawa (ngā taitara papa me te kāri, ngā whakaahuatanga, ngā tākupu, ngā rārangi arowhai, aha atu). Ka whakakite tēnei i te ihirangi huna — ngā tākupu HTML (<!-- -->), te ūnga o ngā hono markdown, JavaScript me ētahi atu waehere — kia kitea te waehere katoa, kia kore e taea te pāwhiri, kia kore hoki e rere. Kua weto taunoatia, nō reira ka tāhuatia noa te markdown.
disable-all-import-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakawetohia ngā āheinga kawemai katoa: te kawemai papa mai i WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea me Forgejo, me te tārua papa hoki. Ka huna ngā kōwhiringa tahua kawemai, ā, ka whakahē te tūmau i ia tono kawemai. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-all-export-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakawetohia ngā āheinga kaweake katoa: te kaweake papa hei WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, ki NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo rānei, me te kaweake āpitihanga takitahi. Ka huna ngā kōwhiringa tahua kaweake, ā, ka whakahē te tūmau i ia tono kaweake. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-import-avatars-description: Ina whakahohea, kāore rawa ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi (ngā pikitia kōtaha kaiwhakamahi) e kawemai. Ka pā tēnei ki te kawemai WeKan JSON, te kawemai Trello me te tukutahi whakaahua kaiwhakamahi mai i ngā kaiwhakarato tuakiri waho i te takiuru (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Ka kawemai tonu ngā ingoa me ētahi atu raraunga; ko ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi anake ka pekea. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-export-avatars-description: Ina whakahohea, kāore rawa ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi (ngā pikitia kōtaha kaiwhakamahi) e whakaurua ina kaweake papa (kaweake WeKan JSON me CSV). Ka kaweake tonu ngā ingoa kaiwhakamahi me ētahi atu raraunga; ko ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi anake ka whakarērea. Kua weto taunoatia.
anonymize-import-users-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakakapi te kawemai papa WeKan JSON i te ingoa kaiwhakamahi, te ingoa katoa me ngā pūmatua tuatahi o ia kaiwhakamahi kawemai ki ngā puriwāhi tatau (user1, user2, ...), ka whakarērea tōna whakaahua kaiwhakamahi, ā, ka tuhi anō i ngā whakahuatanga @username (me ngā āpure requested-by / assigned-by) i roto i te ihirangi kāri me te tākupu kawemai. Kāore he tuakiri kaiwhakamahi tūturu nō te papa pūtake e penapenahia. Ka whai te kupu `user` i te reo o te tangata e kawemai ana. Kua weto taunoatia.
anonymize-export-users-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakakapi te kaweake papa i te ingoa kaiwhakamahi, te ingoa katoa me ngā pūmatua tuatahi o ia kaiwhakamahi kaweake ki ngā puriwāhi tatau (user1, user2, ...), ka whakarērea tōna whakaahua kaiwhakamahi, ā, ka tuhi anō i ngā whakahuatanga @username (me ngā āpure requested-by / assigned-by) i roto i te ihirangi kāri me te tākupu. Kāore he tuakiri kaiwhakamahi tūturu i te kōnae kaweake. Ka whai te kupu `user` i te reo o te tangata e kaweake ana. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-activities-description: Ina whakahohea, kāore rawa ngā tāurunga whāngai-mahi e tuhia, e whakaaturia rānei ki hea (te paetaha papa me te ripa mahi kāri). Kāore he hītori mō wai i mahi i te aha e puritia. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-notifications-description: Ina whakahohea, kāore a WeKan e tuku whakamōhiotanga aroturuki (i-roto-taupānga, īmēra, ratonga kē rānei) mō tētahi mahi. Ka taea tonu te tuhi mahi (ki te kore hoki e monokia i runga ake); ko ngā whakamōhiotanga anake ka pēhia. Kua weto taunoatia.
disable-watch-description: Ina whakahohea, ka whakawetohia te āheinga aroturuki — kāore e taea e ngā kaiwhakamahi te ohauru ki ngā papa, rārangi, kāri rānei hei whiwhi whakamōhiotanga, ā, ka whakahēngia ia whakamātau ki te huri taumata aroturuki. Kua weto taunoatia.
backup-description: Pūruatia ngā Āpitihanga, ngā Whakaahua Kaiwhakamahi me/rānei ngā Raraunga (ngā kohinga ā-kuputuhi katoa ehara i te āpitihanga, i te whakaahua kaiwhakamahi rānei). Ka roma hāngai te .zip ki te putunga kua tīpakohia — kāore he kōnae rangitahi — hei backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, me te YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars me /data kei roto. Ka whakamahi ngā putunga kapua (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) i ngā taipitopito tuakiri kua whirihoratia ki ō rātou ripa putunga.
backup-scope-description: Te taupānga katoa, tētahi Whakahaere rānei. Kei roto i te tārua pūrua a tētahi Whakahaere ōna papa me ngā mea katoa kei runga, tae atu ki ngā āpitihanga o aua papa — engari kāore he pūkete kaiwhakamahi, he tautuhinga taupānga rānei, nā te mea ka tiria ēnā e ia Whakahaere. Ko te whakaora i te tārua pūrua a tētahi Whakahaere ka tuhi anake ki ngā papa nā taua Whakahaere.

azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → tō pūkete → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → tō pūkete → Data storage → Containers → tō ipu (+ Container rānei hei hanga).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → te kaiwhiri kaupapa i runga rawa → te ID o tō kaupapa (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → tō ingoa pākete (Create rānei hei hanga).
